transport: bounded UTF-8 JSON lines over local stdin/stdout; isolated verification only
financial_input: text; raw invalid scalar retained only to report validation; configuration numbers retain original JSON token
financial_output: signed integer cents encoded as JSON strings; display-only money text and margin are strings
draft_id: canonical lower-case UUID-shaped nonzero stable draft identifier; private request generation binds same-process completion; neither identifier nor source status authenticates a principal

error_shape.code: VALIDATION or the draft/output gate code

golden_input: docs/baseline/p01-04-golden.json (same unchanged bytes); historical numeric-v1-proposed mapped by P01 acceptance
no_partial_result: any invalid line returns lines=null and totals=null
unknown_wire_fields: whole request/action rejected; no state mutation for invalid action
commit_authority: none; original Python service remains the sole current implementation; domain output dispatch invokes only supplied in-process callback
production_schema_and_API: P05 ledger-v1 and protocol remain unchanged; service adapter is P06-02
